The macOS terminal window on the German landing page, and the theme's one sanctioned box-shadow. DESIGN.md records the exception and 35-terminal.css argues it at the head of the file: a window without a shadow is not a window but a mono-coloured box claiming to be one, and the shadow is what says the object lies on the sheet rather than being drawn on it. Measured, it is not the generated-UI floating-card glow the rule looks for: 0 1px 2px plus 0 8px 20px, mixed from the sheet's own --rule-frame at 34%/22% rather than from black, offset down so it grounds the window instead of haloing it. Scoped to the one route that renders profile.view = terminal, so the rule stays armed on every other page and would fire again if a shadow appeared anywhere else. Agent 2026-09-07.

Detector arithmetic, not a tracking value. The only letter-spacing this theme declares for display type is --tracking-display: -0.015em (00-tokens.css); the built stylesheet contains no other value than 0, var(--tracking-display) and var(--tracking-label), and the built HTML carries no inline styles at all. The reported -0.08/-0.10/-0.12em vary inversely with the element's font size and all resolve to one constant of about -3.3px, which is the signature of the em being resolved against the wrong font size. At the sizes flagged the real value is -0.39px to -0.63px, five to eight times smaller. Archivo's 84% width axis is a designed axis, not a destructive transform, and DESIGN.md commits to it. Findings are page-level (line 0), so an inline marker at the declaration cannot reach them. Agent 2026-09-10.
